people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”
translations.bsb: When the people heard this, they were cut to the heart and asked Peter and the other apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”
translations.kjv: Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?
translations.asv: Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and the rest of the apostles, Brethren, what shall we do?
